'''Lo'Uran''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its governor was [[Blithane]].

==History==
This remote planet was marginally controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], which deemed the world too far-removed to warrant a full [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]].
